R2B-deer-backcountry-0002.name: 350 m NE of Brittain River
R2B-deer-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R2B-deer-backcountry-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Deer here are black tailed deer, the coast form of mule deer: the synopsis calls them "mule (black-tailed) deer" (99%, Rule Book: Region 2 Lower Mainland).
Mule deer winter range u-2-011 unit BR 11 (official), 30 m NE. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2006 (20 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHdm2): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
S facing slope, 16 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 220 m W: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-09): get permission first or go around.
Private land 220 m W: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from District of Squamish, about 91 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.97621, -124.07255, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,141 m, about 223 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 470 m S of the spot at 0 m (49.9969, -124.00742). Water: Brittain River 170 m W (estimate).
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2006 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-12, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R2B-deer-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 2-12: about 2,122 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.53 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R2B-grouse-drive-0003.name: 440 m NW of Freda Lake

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
10 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
12 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

Park: 50.00979, -124.16012, pull off on Stillwater Mainline (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Stillwater Mainline stretch, 4.7 km one way. About 93 min one way at 3 km/h.
